limits: CPU gas-only rendering with exact full-engine triangle depth, not Babylon GPU execution.
Both old/new fields use the same current rigid geometry and exact depth clipping; previous means source-model comparison, not historical renderer reproduction.
Ground, airframe, surface emission/reflection, scattering and scene light are excluded. Rear powered-lift cameras may lie below the hypothetical ground.
All spectra/temperatures/particle assumptions remain uncalibrated for F135. Numerical integration alone does not establish appearance acceptance.
